notes.title: HAAK | The New DLC Black & White Officially releases today!
notes.content:
As the final DLC of HAAK, Black & White will be the perfect end for HAAK. Thank all the Haakers who have supported us for so long and hope you enjoy the excitement and puzzle-solving challenges of this final chapter you’ve never experienced before.
(The final chapter of the story will be automatically updated as a part of the game, which means our players have no need to download the DLC separately)
 
[h3]The following is the content of this update:[/h3]
 
[b][h3][u]Challenges and story[/u][/h3][/b]
-A new explorable area has been added in 【Bunker 444】. Don’t forget to find Yaam to have a small chat! Provided she's not mad at you yet, of course.
-A super huge stage has been added to the game, containing brand-new gameplay, and game mechanics as well as the craziest[spoiler]parkour[/spoiler] in the history of HAAK!
-A brand-new chapter brings the end to HAAK’s story! Hooray!
-A new ending! And there’s more! Also, don’t miss the bonus scene at the end of the game. We have put a lot of effort into it!
-A new item has been added to the collection, standing for love from[spoiler]Chuka[/spoiler].
 
[h3][b][u]New Modes[/u][/b][/h3]
- The Boss Rush you’ve all been waiting for comes! Of course, we’ll call it the Newie Coins Challenge in HAAK. You know what I mean? Come break the record of 965 points and win the reward of different colors of headgear!
-What? You say you’re not interested in the difficult challenges and even want to make the journey easier? No problem! Have a try on the Super Baby Mode that has been launched by Genius Technology! You can find the options in the Greenie coins shop. But, Genie will have to remind you that you’d better turn to these options only when you’re in a very difficult situation, as the options stand for an abyss that will devour all the experiences you should have…
-If you want to listen to Yaam’s songs again, you can find a special entrance in the title screen of the game to do so! But you need to complete a [spoiler]new ending[/spoiler] to unlock it.
 
[h3][u][b]Other updates[/b][/u][/h3]
-Two achievements have been added. Rest assured for those of you who are eager to have all the achievements, because the two can be unlocked easily during your playing process.
-Haak is now a cat person! Caat will show up in your apartment and start walking around as well as playing. Of course, provided that you’ll bring her home.
-Now the total exploration is over 100%! What’s the limit of yours? Well, I say for myself, 107%!
-The Steam Interchange Cards and items from Point Store are officially released in HAAK!
-All the achievements and records of Boss Rush along with the rewards can now be preserved in the game for good! Also, they can be shared in all the saves!
- Other small repairs and optimizations.

[h3][u][b]Language[/b][/u][/h3]
We have added the following languages to our original supported languages (English, Korean, Japanese, Russian, Portuguese, French, Spanish, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese).
- Hindi
- Indonesian
- Tagalog
- Filipino
- Turkish
- Vietnamese
- Thai
- Arabic
- Malay
- Kazakh
- Italian
- Polish
- German

The final chapter of the story will be automatically updated as part of the game, which means our players no need to download the DLC separately.

notes.title: HAAK v1.0 is coming soon
notes.content:
Hello, HAAKers! Thanks for your waiting and we are excited to share the good news.
HAAK v1.0 has been completed! We sincerely appreciate all HAAKers' support during the Early Access.

The official release date will be announced soon. With the update of the official version, the price of the game will also change. We will raise the price to $17.99 on March 28, 2022. New players can join us now！

Here is new key visual art for HAAK!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458630/f59eaec60a40034d0130e1515fd974c4f67070eb.png[/img]
Major update on v1.0
1. Double the amount of levels and game content.
1) Compared with the updated levels in Early Access, the official version will have seven new maps and a wealth of side quests, and the playing time will be increased by at least 20 hours!
2) The poisonous Merlin Pit, the foggy Anthony Hill, the dangerous Imperial Mansion, etc. Each level has a different visual experience, and will meet more journey partners and opponents!
3) At the same time, in addition to the main task, there are also more than ten new side quests, including encounters with a moral dilemma. Your decision will permanently change the fate of those NPCs ......

3. New gameplay makes the journey no longer lonely
In the official version, in addition to the original core gameplay, we have added many new fun systems, such as
1) a new video hall, HAAKer can use the (seemingly useless) discs to exchange skills
2) Players， previously struggling with teleport and save, now can use the "mobile toilet" to achieve their wishes

What will be the end of the story of the underground world? All waiting for you to explore!

In addition to these gameplay updates, the studio also added a lot of enemies, but also optimized the operation, greatly improving the experience and smoothness of the game. We welcome our new friends and HAAKers to have a try!
The above is the foresight of HAAK v1.0.
See you in v1.0!

Level
-Added an exclusive 'Greenie Coins' vending machine to Merlin Pit, which can reduce the difficulty of the corresponding escape sequence and Boss battles

-Optimized edge sliding: When performing dash, diving thrust, jumping, thrust up and other actions, the actions will be less jammed by the edge of the platform. -Shortened the maximum recovery time for after landing to 0.5 seconds

notes.title: Dev log #1 & Preview of the Chapter 4 updates in October
notes.content:
Dear HAAKers!

Since we released HAAK on EA 2 weeks ago, we've received many support and feedback from many of you and we sincerely appreciate for this.

We want to thank you for the suggestions and ideas on game design, as well as in-game bugs reported. 

Every single piece of feedback have provided us with very useful inspiration and guidance for our future development. Now we have released 3 patches based on the information received since September 16th, the main contents include:

[h2]Patch 7176M:[/h2]

- to fix issues such as black screen, stutter frames, and unusual audio volume caused by reading configuration files
- Breakable tiles will reset after saving the game.

[h2]Patch 7207EA:[/h2]

- Fixed data reading issues when creating a new game when there are multiple games saved
- Fixed the loading issue when respawning back in Sanhe Ruins
- Fixed the issue where the power engine in the North Station couldn’t reset after player respawn, if progress not saved
- Fixed the possible lagging and gravity issues during boss battle with Wang Ping
- Added feedback prompt on the HUD, which can be disabled in Settings
- Added feedback report servers to solve the problem with the progress updates in feedback.

And some advices for you: 
1. For players using Nvidia 27.21.14.5148, or players experiencing unexpected game shut-down, please try updating the Graphics Card Driver to the latest version 27.21.14.5206(452.06)
2. Some controller issues may be caused by abnormal connections. Please try to unplug the controller and reconnect it. If it still can't work, please send a feedback report.
3. For players who met with data reading issues (most of you may be unable to leave the scene after returning to the Sanhe Ruins back), you can upload the error log through the BUG feedback system and leave your contact information, if you don't mind, so we can repair the data and resend it to you. (Of course, this is a very rare situation)

[h2]Patch 7388P1:[/h2]

Skills, operations and interaction
- All attack moves have been accelerated to a certain extent
- Electric Hook Adjustment: Reduced forward and backward swing time
- Electric Hook Adjustment: Jumping, dash and melee attack actions can now interrupt the hook retract time
-Electric Hook Adjustment: launching a hook in the air now needs to wait for the melee attack action to complete before releasing
- Electric Hook Adjustment: Fixed the bug where the electric hook could launch through a narrow gate
- Electric Hook Adjustment: Direction of the hook towing point made more obvious
- Bullets bounced back by the player will now bounce straight back to the launch point with added speed
- Dash Adjustment: In between hook actions and attack actions, Dash will be performed towards the current input direction
- Optimized the level difficulties of Sanhe Ruins and Subway Tunnel
- Countdown visual effect of the timing pile is now more accurate on reflecting the next current turn-on time

Levels
- Optimized the level difficulties of Sanhe Ruins and Subway Tunnel
- Adjusted unreasonable level design reported throughout the game
- Fixed the issue where a moving box in Sanhe ruins resets itself after re-loading game progress
- Fixed an issue that could cause achievement to be unlocked in advance
- Fixed an issue that may cause a stuck in the North Station

Enemies
- Adjusted difficulties for Boss Wang Ping
+ Reduced damage frame of stone pillars
+ Wang Ping's ground sprint will now deal damage to the player
+ Wang Ping's moves now with a reduced backswing
+ Increased Wang Ping's health point 
- Adjusted difficulties for Coolie (The enemy character with a big stick lol)
+ Increased movement speed
+ Increased attack damage
+ Increased the initiative of its attack
+ Moves now with a reduced backswing
- Slime with damage is now more visible

Bugs fixed
- Fixed issue that could prevent players from launching attacks after landing from a jump
- Fixed issue where a player might cross the terrain when being squeezed
- Fixed an issue where the pressure plate might get the enemies to be stuck on
- Fixed un-proportional zoom ratio when using the map in aiming mode
- Fixed the issue that could cause the program to freeze when sending feedback
- Fixed the total game time display issue: now when the game is off the time will not be counted
- Fixed possible abnormal BGM caused by loading game progress in Sanhe Ruins
- Fixed possible abnormal sound effect when landing from a high jump
- Fixed the unlock bug for achievement 【Flee on Foot】
- Fixed the bug where the bomb placed during the countdown might become invalid after player entering and leaving the room
- Fixed a display error of collectables within a map in North Station
- Fixed an issue where a hanging point could cause the player to teleport elsewhere
- Fixed the issue with the incorrect number displayed of collected objects after reading game progress
- Fixed the problem with some gates in a level not opening after reading game progress
- Fixed text display errors

Add
- Updated some in-game sound effects
- Added controller support based on Steam Input, including PS4, Switch Pro and other Steam Input controllers will be automatically mapped to XBOX controller setting

Last but not least, [h2]we will be updating the 4th Chapter of HAAK in October! [/h2]

Where will Haak head to after escaping from the Metro Tunnels? New stories will be waiting for him to explore, and who will join him in his adventure?

The greater truth awaits you to reveal！

Thank you everyone for the valuable feedback along the way, and we look forward to receiving more!
Then we will be waiting for you in Chapter 4! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: HAAK Q&A
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458630/e7a8ec626ea2c8c4851076c060e27fea4fe88497.jpg[/img]

Hi Haakers! ːsteamhappyː

Thank you for following our game HAAK, we have put together a few frequently asked questions from players, hope that helps! But do not hesitate to ask us anything or leave any feedback, we would love to hear them!

[h3]Q: When will the game be released?[/h3]
A: The plan is to keep polishing the game for another 12 months after the EA release, we will work hard for it to be released around late 2021.

[h3]Q: What does “HAAK” stand for?[/h3]
A: Our studio is based in Guangdong, China. Haak means 'black' in Cantonese, and black is the key colour of our protagonist, as well as the game aesthetic. Secondly, we have designed a hacking skill as a core game mechanic, which is pronounced the same as HAAK.
Interestingly, we just discovered Haak means Hook in Dutch, which surprisingly is the main weapon used in the game!

[h3]Q: Is this game a Metroidvania game?[/h3]
A: HAAK was massively affected by Metroidvania games like Super Metroid, but at the same time drawing inspiration from action-adventure games like The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. Therefore HAAK is more like a combination of all the goodness, we would describe it as a Metroidvania-lite game.

[h3]Q: A metroidvania released as EA?[/h3]
A: It does sound pretty weird for a Metroidvania game to be released as Early Access, but as we mentioned before, HAAK is not a traditional Metroidvania game, therefore, there is a special world and logic setting, which would make it suitable for EA release. 

[h3]Q: HAAK reminds me of other games.[/h3]
A: We are a small and young team, HAAK is our first PC/Console title. We always wish to learn from successful games that we love and respect. So there might be some elements in common with other games, but we are sure that HAAK is unique and independent, and we believe that HAAK will bring a very different experience to our players.

[h3]Q: How can HAAK stand out in its genre?[/h3]
A: First, the art style of HAAK is pretty iconic. It is a brave experiment for us to combine dark manga and high-resolution pixel art.  As for the animation, Haak employs fully hand-rendered, high-frame-rate 2D animation
The game also focuses heavily on the background story and world setting, weaving this dystopian near future story with East Asian cultures into the gameplay.

[h3]Q: Will you be able to select the difficulties of the game？[/h3]
A: Currently we have only one difficulty setting, but we are working on a system which can automatically adjust the level of difficulty, which will be taking into consideration after we gained feedback from players during EA.

[h3]Q: Will HAAK come to mobile or consoles?[/h3]
A: It is definitely in our consideration, but for now we wish to focus on developing the PC version to the finest quality.

[h3]Q: How many hours of play for HAAK?[/h3]
A: There will be 3 regions to explore in the EA version, which requires an average of 4-5 hours of play time, as results form our early playtesters. 
The full game will have about 2 times of contents more than the EA version, so an estimate of more than 10 hours of gameplay.

[h3]Q: Any DLCs planned for the future? [/h3]
A: We're focusing on the game right now, but we will definitely consider DLCs. For now, focusing on main game 1st ;)

[h3]Q: Will it be a linear experience or will it feature different paths/choices/endings?[/h3]
A: We are definitely planning this, where there could be many choices player will have to make throughout the adventure, which might affect the ending. We wish to make the endings together with the help of our players, by collecting thoughts and feedback during EA.

[h3]Q: Will the game have voiced parts? [/h3]
A: Unfortunately there is no plan for VO for HAAK. Due to the speical world setting in HAAK, the use for VO might not add to the overall game experience, however inapropriete use of voice parts could make a negative effect, therefore we decided to remove it.

[h3]Q: What languages will be avaliable for the game? [/h3]
A: For the EA release, HAAK will support English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Russian. We wish to collect players' feedback on which other languages to bring in for the game's final release.

If you have more questions or feedback, please do not hesitate to reach us through our steam community or [url=https://twitter.com/haakgame]Twitter[/url]/[url=https://discord.gg/Jxnf6ee]Discord[/url]/[url=https://www.facebook.com/gamehaak]Facebook[/url]!
